pr.title: Simplify and improve Executable launch argument computation
pr.author: karolz-ms

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, debug-dashboard)
failed_jobs.reason: Generic exit code 1 failure in the VS Code extension E2E 'debug-dashboard' shard with no retrievable job logs or TRX test failures. The PR only modifies Aspire.Hosting executable launch argument computation and its own tests (Aspire.Hosting/ApplicationModel, Dcp, and related unit tests); it does not touch the VS Code extension or dashboard debug-configuration code, so this shard's failure is unrelated to the PR changes. This matches a recurring pattern of similarly generic, unrelated VS Code extension E2E shard failures (e.g. apphost-lifecycle-tools, java-apphost, settings-files, apphost-tree, dynamic-debug-configuration, edge-cases) already tracked as flaky.
